snippet.title: Pokémon Café ReMix | Set Sail for the Sea 🌊
snippet.description:
Ahoy, Trainers—summer is in full swing, and you’re invited to join our ocean crew!

🏴‍☠️ Meet Lapras in its five-star sea captain outfit, starting July 23. More members of the sea crew will also appear! 

🪸 Customize your café with nautical, sea-themed decorations soon 

🌊 Beginning July 23, discover Alolan Meowth, Totodile, and Minccino one after another in their special crew-themed outfits 

👒 Log in to recruit Jigglypuff in its summer fun outfit to your staff 

Learn more: https://pkmn.news/PokemonCafeReMix 🍰 

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
Official Site: https://www.pokemon.com
Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/pokemon
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@pokemonofficial
